notes.title: Update（2/13）
notes.content:
- Added "Freeze".

- Changed the effect of some units.

- Added some animations.

- Fixed some bugs.

notes.content:
- Add achievement.

- Changed to be able to get skin in test mode

notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that did not start match

- When winning in Choice mode, Rare skin became easier to come out.

notes.title: Update（2/7）Add new mode
notes.content:
・I add "Choice" mode. In this mode you do not need to build a deck.
